landing.support: Pick places on a beautiful map, build days you can walk, journal on the road, and share.
trips.title: Your trips
trips.support: A map-first trip space — playbooks, samples, or days you shaped yourself.
trips.empty: No trips of your own yet. Start from a city playbook or open the Kyoto sample.
trips.placeholder.osakaMeta: Sample · join with an invite code
trips.templatesSupport: Read-only templates: create a new trip with days and stops, then edit freely.
auth.support: Sign in to create trips, invite companions, and co-edit the same map.
auth.providers: Email, Apple, and Google. WeChat login can be enabled in Clerk.
auth.wechatReady: WeChat OAuth is flagged on — choose WeChat in the Clerk sign-in panel.
auth.wechatHint: WeChat: add the WeChat social connection in Clerk, then set NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_WECHAT_ENABLED=true.
auth.wechatStartFailed: Could not start WeChat OAuth. Confirm the WeChat social connection in Clerk Dashboard.
auth.demoBody: Without real Clerk keys, the web app uses a local demo identity (demo-user) against the BFF. No secrets are faked.
auth.demoStep1: Create an app at dashboard.clerk.com and copy pk_ / sk_ keys
auth.demoStep2: Put them in apps/web/.env.local and apps/api/.dev.vars
auth.demoStep3: Optional: enable WeChat social connection + NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_WECHAT_ENABLED=true
mobile.signInExpoHint: Expo: set EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (+ EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_WECHAT_ENABLED=true for WeChat).
collab.shareHint: Share the link or code so companions can join this trip.
collab.panel.title: Notes & activity
collab.panel.support: Leave a note for companions, or skim what changed on this trip.
collab.panel.emptyComments: No comments yet. Start the thread for this trip.
collab.panel.placeholder: Write a note… type @ to mention a companion
collab.panel.mentionHint: Mentions match member display names, e.g. @Companion
collab.panel.viewerReadonly: Viewers can read the thread but cannot post.
invite.title: Join a shared trip
invite.support: Someone invited you to plan together on Beaver Plan. Confirm your role and open the shared map.
invite.demoNote: Without Clerk keys, the demo identity (X-Beaver-User-Id) can accept invites.
mobile.homeHint: On the road: Today · Next stop · Journal · Translate
planner.notFound: Trip not found. Is the API running?
planner.searchPlaceholder: Search places, e.g. Kiyomizu, The Bund…
planner.emptyDayHint: Search above and add a place — the map and list light up together.
planner.hint: Without map keys the planner uses demo data. Add Google / Amap / Baidu server keys and the BFF switches to live Places + Directions.
planner.demoLocal: Demo shell — stops update locally until Neon/API is available.
planner.transfer.title: Transfer steps
planner.transfer.hint: Map polylines are styled by walk / ride / transfer; expand the list for durations and line names.
planner.dayFill.title: Smart day fill
planner.dayFill.support: Propose a day plan from interests and a daily walk budget — preview first, then apply.
planner.dayFill.empty: No draft yet. Pick interests and generate.
journal.support: Short notes per day or stop, with photos — magazine pages, not a form.
journal.emptyHint: Compose on the right — a line from the road, with a few photos.
journal.composeHint: Caption + photos, bound to today or a stop.
journal.placeholder: Morning light, a lantern street, a line you want to keep…
journal.uploadHint: Uploads to R2 via signed S3 URL (falls back to API PUT)
share.title: Share studio
share.support: Pick a template from today’s footprint — Moments / Xiaohongshu ready.
share.demoHint: API returns SVG → browser canvas exports PNG. Photos load from R2 (S3 API); set S3_* / R2_* env on the API. Edits apply to this export only.
translate.title: Live translation
translate.support: Two-way speak · dual-camera captions. Scripted demo turns when keys are unset.
translate.empty: Hold the mic, or type a line from the road.
translate.caption: Scene caption
translate.cameraHint: Point at a menu or sign — OCR overlays the subtitle.
translate.permissionMic: Microphone permission is needed for conversation mode.
translate.permissionCamera: Camera permission is needed for lens assist.
translate.webSupport: Desktop debug: mic or type → same BFF. Chunked partials while you hold the mic.
translate.phrasebookHint: Cached lines for airplane mode — tap to speak the translation.
offline.pinHint: Cache this trip’s days, stops, journal text, and last-known route lines for airplane mode.
offline.statusHint: Journal notes queue offline and flush when you reconnect. Full vendor map tiles are not downloaded — only stop pins + last polylines.
offline.savedLocal: Saved offline — will sync when online
offline.limits: Offline limits: trip cache + journal queue only; no Baidu/Google offline tile packs; conflicts use last-write-wins with trip version.
planner.booking.title: Bookings
planner.booking.support: Save hotel, flight, and ticket deep links on a stop — open externally when you need them.
planner.booking.selectStop: Select a stop in the list to edit its booking links.
planner.booking.suggestSupport: Demo catalog by city and dates — no payment. Wire Amadeus / Booking affiliate later via env.
planner.booking.cityRequired: Enter a city to search suggestions.
planner.booking.hint: No checkout in Beaver Plan — links open the provider site. Payment and inventory sync stay out of scope.
